title: Vinxx's Custom 3D items
description: Custom 3D items based  mostly on animes
body:
Hello wussup! So this is my first 3D custom model data resource pack that i made, and i decided to post it online to maybe get a feedback for my models.
This Texture packs adds Custom Model data items to minecraft that can be made by renaming items in anvils, i add something in it when i'm see something cool. 

I make the model with blockbench, you better check it out and see if it has some problems, then you can report it to me. 

**YOU MUST USE** [Citresewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn)/[Optifine](https://optifine.net/home) to work or else the items cannot rendered

Here some of the items that you can rename : 

## **Weapons** :
1. _Yukimura 1/3_ (sword)
2. _Sanguine Dagger_ (sword)
3. _OOO Medagabyru Axe_ (axe)
4. _FullBottle Buster Blade Mode_ (sword)
5. _FullBottle Buster Blaster Mode_ (crossbow)
6. _Tsukuyomi Kunai_ (sword)
7. _Moonshadow Sword_ (sword)
8. _Light Moonshadow Sword_ (sword)
9. _Dark Moonshadow Sword_ (sword) **NOTE : FOR NOW, DARK MOONSHADOW SWORD CAN ONLY BE USED WHEN A PLAYER HAS A LEFT MAIN HAND OR ELSE IT LOOKED WEIRD**
10. _Rengoku no Toge_ (sword)
11. _Sorcerer Killer_ (sword)
12. _Three-Section Staff_ (sword) 

## **Hats(All use carved_pumpkin)** :
1. _Vigilante Scarf_
2. _Rage Eyes_
3. _Rage Scarf_
4. _Mythical Beast Amber Scarf_
5. _Monster_
6. _Monster Blood_
7. _Monster Soul_ 



_______________________________________________________________________________________________

Recommended for using [RP Renames](https://modrinth.com/mod/rp-renames) Mod, so you can easily find what you want to rename :D.
